name: Pagination
description: Moves between the pages of a long list: previous and next, the first and last pages, the pages around the current one, and an optional summary.

livewire.name: pagination
capabilities: rows takes a Laravel paginator: pages become links to its URLs, and inside a Livewire component with WithPagination they call gotoPage() instead of reloading
A simple or cursor paginator renders previous and next only

vue.name: Pagination
capabilities: v-model:page binds the page (update:page) alongside page-change

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, from 1. Clamped to the page count.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: How many pages there are. Without it, Pagination works it out from total and perPage.

props.name: total
props.description: How many items the whole list has. With perPage it gives the page count and the summary's range.

props.name: perPage
props.description: How many items a page holds.

props.name: siblings
props.description: How many pages show on each side of the current one. The first and last pages always show, and gaps collapse into an ellipsis, so the control keeps one width as the page changes.

props.name: summary
props.description: Shows the summary before the pages: "Showing 21–30 of 318", or "Page 3 of 32" without a total.

props.name: rows
props.description: A Laravel paginator (LengthAwarePaginator, Paginator or CursorPaginator). It supplies page, total, perPage and each page's URL; a simple or cursor paginator renders previous and next only.

props.name: label
props.description: The navigation landmark's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Pagination' ).
props.a11y: Names the nav landmark; give two paginations on one page different labels.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: The previous button's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Previous page' ).
props.a11y: The previous button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: The next button's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Next page' ).
props.a11y: The next button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: Each page's accessible name; {page} is its number. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Page {page}' ).

props.name: summaryLabel
props.description: The summary's text, with {from}, {to}, {total}, {page} and {pageCount}. Without a total the default is "Page {page} of {pageCount}". Translate it: Livewire defaults both through __().

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { page: '…', summary: '…' }.

parts.name: summary
parts.description: Which items or page are showing, when summary is set.

parts.name: previous
parts.description: Goes to the previous page. Icon-only, named by previousLabel; aria-disabled on the first page. Its chevron mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: page
parts.description: Goes to a page. The current page has aria-current="page".

parts.name: ellipsis
parts.description: Stands in for the pages between two shown ones. Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: next
parts.description: Goes to the next page. Icon-only, named by nextLabel; aria-disabled on the last page. Its chevron mirrors in RTL.

events.name: page-change
events.description: A page, previous or next was chosen. Setting page doesn't fire it. Livewire dispatches it as a browser event (x-on:page-change, wire:page-change) with { page } in $event.detail.

keyboard.action: Moves through previous, the pages and next.
Goes to the focused page (Enter only on links).

requirements: A nav landmark named by label ("Pagination").
Previous and next are icon-only with translatable names; on the first or last page they stay focusable with aria-disabled="true" and do nothing.
Each page is named "Page n" (pageLabel); ellipses are aria-hidden.
Previous and next chevrons mirror in RTL, and the order follows the text direction.
Items are at least --apui-control-height-sm (28px) square, above the 24px target minimum.
